svg.title: Partial Design — Register Arrival and Record Consultation (design only)

g.text: Partial Design — Register Arrival and Record Consultation (design only)
Staged domain changes and success audit are committed together.
Failure discards all staged changes (original contracts CR1/CR2).
This describes in-memory atomicity, not a required database implementation.
These are the target design classes used by interactions 2 and 3.
They extend the scheduling design; they are not implemented by the PoC.
Arrival stays confirmed; recording consultation changes status to completed.
Existing Appointment, ClinicalRecord, Consultation and AuditRecord concepts are retained.
